subject: Audit-log retention tiers & committed discount structure for Crescent Health
messages:
From: Sam Carter <sam.carter@crescenthealth.com>
To: alex.martinez@redwood.com
Cc: linda.zhou@crescenthealth.com, ben.atwood@crescenthealth.com
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs / KMS pricing questions (RFP attached)

Alex —

Thanks for the quick response last week. Attached is the relevant section of our RFP focused on observability and key management (Crescent_RFP_audit_requirements.pdf). A few specific asks so we can evaluate options before procurement review:

- Audit log retention: we need pricing for 90 / 365 / 730 day retention tiers, and an estimate of monthly cost per GB retained. Willing to consider a committed volume discount if we prepay.
- KMS/HSM: please provide both host-managed KMS pricing and an option for dedicated HSM seats. Any one-time setup fees vs recurring management fees should be clearly broken out.
- Data residency: Crescent requires US-only residency for PHI with a second option for EU for test/dev. Include any region premium.
- Compliance evidence: can you include SOC 2 dates and a pointer to how we can get an AICPA letter?

Procurement timeline: we are aiming to reach commercial terms by end of May; legal will want a clear breakout of one-time vs annual fees for budget planning.

Can you send a short priced matrix + a sample term sheet we can show procurement/legal? We may ask for a committed discount if we move to a 24–36 month capacity commitment.

Thanks,
Sam
Sam Carter
Senior Procurement Manager
Crescent Health Systems

(Attachment: Crescent_RFP_audit_requirements.pdf)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs / KMS pricing questions (RFP attached)

Hi Sam —

Thanks for the RFP extract — useful level of detail. I pulled together an initial pricing matrix and a few contract options (see attached quote). High-level summary below so you can share with procurement/legal quickly:

Audit log retention (price per GB/month):
- 90 days: $0.02/GB/month
- 365 days: $0.015/GB/month
- 730 days: $0.011/GB/month
Notes: retention pricing is linear; we can offer a 6-month free retention credit on audit logs with a 12-month committed capacity purchase (see discounts).

KMS/HSM options:
- Host-managed KMS (customer keys in Redwood-managed HSM): $0 one-time setup, $0.005/10k requests, $500/month management fee
- Dedicated HSM seat: $12,000 one-time provisioning, $1,200/month per seat (includes monitoring and key-rotation support)
Notes: HSM seats are required for FIPS-level two-key policies; we can limit initial seats and add more as needed.

Data residency premium:
- US residency (PHI): +8% on recurring inference and persistence charges
- EU test/dev region: +4% when selected

Committed discounts (illustrative):
- $100k annual commit: 8% platform discount + audit-log credit (3 months free)
- $250k annual commit: 12% platform discount + audit-log credit (6 months free)
- $500k+ annual commit: 18% platform discount + audit-log credit (12 months free)

Breaking out one-time vs recurring costs and providing a term sheet is in the attached spreadsheet (redwood-quote-20260421.xlsx).

Next steps: can we schedule a 30-min call this week with your procurement and legal to walk through the matrix? If you’d like, I can include our security lead on the call to cover SOC 2 / evidentiary items.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

(Attachment: redwood-quote-20260421.xlsx)

From: Linda Zhou <linda.zhou@crescenthealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs / KMS pricing questions (RFP attached)

Alex/Laura —

Thanks — a couple quick legal/compliance clarifications before we move to procurement:

1) Audit log access and deletion: we need to confirm a formal SLA for log availability (99.9%) and a defined process for log deletion requests that ties to our data retention policy.
2) KMS key custody: for PHI keys we would prefer customer-held keys; can you confirm what controls exist for key export, split-key policies, and whether you support key mirroring across regions?
3) Liability and indemnity: will you accept a limited data-related liability cap for breach of PHI processing tied to the paid add-on?
4) SOC 2: please provide the latest report and the auditor contact or a download link — our compliance team will need to review.

Also, please provide a more granular line-item breakout (one-time provisioning fees vs monthly recurrence), as well as an option that assumes a 36-month term for budget planning.

Best,
Linda Zhou
Senior Counsel, Crescent Health Systems

On Mon, Apr 20, 2026 at 09:05 AM Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Sam —
> 
> Thanks for the RFP extract — useful level of detail. I pulled together an initial pricing matrix and a few contract options (see attached quote). High-level summary below so you can share with procurement/legal quickly: ...

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Crescent — concession / discount approach

Team —

Quick internal note before I get back to Crescent. Linda asked for SLAs and SOC 2; procurement wants a 36-month budget option. Proposed approach:

- Offer structure: keep list pricing as-is but provide a committed discount ladder (100k / 250k / 500k) — see attached pricing_strategy_notes.txt for the matrix.
- Concessions we can make without escalation: up to 12% total discount on platform fees for a 24-month commit; include 6 months audit-log retention credit.
- Stretch concession (requires RevOps approval): up to 18% discount at $500k+ commit and waive first-month HSM management fee for first two seats.
- Compliance asks: Rishi, can you prepare an SOC 2 cover note and confirm whether we can provide a read-only export for audit logs and an API-driven deletion workflow?
- Legal posture: Laura, feel free to soften indemnity language to a data-related liability cap aligned with our standard enterprise policy; if they push for more, we escalate.

I’ll send an updated quote with the 36-month column and schedule a call with procurement. Need agreement on the 12% no-escalate threshold.

Thanks — Alex

(Attachment: pricing_strategy_notes.txt)

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sam Carter <sam.carter@crescenthealth.com>, Linda Zhou <linda.zhou@crescenthealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2026 17:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Audit logs / KMS pricing questions (RFP attached) — updated quote and next steps

Sam / Linda —

Appreciate the quick turn. Per our internal review we’ve produced an updated quote that includes the 36-month term column, a detailed breakout of one-time vs recurring fees, and a committed discount path. Key changes:

- We can offer a 12% platform discount for a 24-month committed spend of $250k (no escalation).
- For a 36-month commit at $500k+, we can move to 18% and provide a waiver of the first-month HSM management fee for up to two seats.
- Audit log retention credits: 6 months free with 24-month commit; 12 months free with 36-month $500k+ commit.
- SOC 2: Rishi will share the SOC 2 cover note and a secure link to the report in the next email.
- SLA & deletion: we will include a 99.9% availability target for audit-log access and a documented deletion request workflow in the SOW.

Attached is the updated spreadsheet (redwood-quote-20260421.xlsx) and a DocuSign form we can use once procurement confirms the line items (docusign-initial-link). Can we lock a 30-min call Friday to walk procurement/legal through the numbers?

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to procurement.

—Alex
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0148

(Attachments: redwood-quote-20260421.xlsx, docusign-initial-link)
